checks.name: Original archive behavior reproduced: SDK29 metadata present but signingInfo null; SDK34 normal
Production archive helper, real published APK and pinned certificate on actual Android29/34 emulators
Final source unit tests and signed validation
Exact tag tests, signing and publication
Installed updater API and release-order guard, read-only

limitations: The user reported WRONG_UPDATE_PACKAGE. Its exact device-specific cause was not reproduced. The stock Android10 certificate bug would trigger UPDATE_SIGNATURE_MISMATCH in the prior app; the error codes were split in 1.22.
The native probe parses and verifies the existing real 1.21 APK with the new production helper; it does not install/run the ARM VPN on an x86 emulator.
Private subscription and actual phone were unavailable. TIMEOUT plus fetched=0 establishes a failed fetch, not a parser failure.
Own-tunnel routing is corrected and tested with a loopback proxy; not every timeout is confirmed fixed.
Manual APK installation over the existing app may be required once, since the old installed updater cannot execute its replacement code before installation.
